core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mutahar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Purified, pure”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mutahar corresponds to the Arabic form مُطَهَّر (Arabic root ط ه ر (ṭ-h-r); مُطَهَّر (Muṭahhar)). Its core sense is mutahar; purified, pure. Mutahar is Arabic مُطَهَّر (Muṭahhar) 'purified, pure', from the root ط ه ر (ṭ-h-r). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave مُتَحَر (a non-standard form); the correct form is مُطَهَّر. The source gloss 'Pious, Wise' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mutahir.
